findings.description: Outbound HTTP requests present without private IP / loopback / cloud metadata SSRF guard.
Returned tool payloads are returned raw without structured untrusted content tags.

Critical Tollbooth Bypass via TRIAL_MODE Environment Variable: The 'slack_post_message' tool's monetization mechanism can be completely bypassed by setting the 'TRIAL_MODE' environment variable to 'true'. Furthermore, the default behavior of `os.getenv("TRIAL_MODE", "true")` means that if the 'TRIAL_MODE' variable is not explicitly set, the system defaults to trial mode, effectively allowing free usage by default. This renders the entire 'pay-per-call' model non-functional and allows agents to invoke the monetized function indefinitely without incurring any cost.
